text:
maya: FYI onboarding sample-app (node) hit a nasty corner: embed batching helper sometimes returns misaligned vectors when auth retry happens mid-batch. repro included in thread.

ryan: can you show the exact payload/response? is the API dropping entries or shifting indexes?

maya: shifting + nulls. sent 4 inputs; got 4 entries but one is null and another embedding repeated. looks like mapping by position after retry. snippet: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings
body: { inputs: ["q1","q2","q3","q4"], batch_size: 4 }
response: { data: [ {embedding: [/*512floats*/] }, null, {embedding: [/*512floats*/]}, {embedding: [/*512floats*/] } ] }
```

li: hm. node batch helper currently uses queue index to remap responses back to callers. if a retry cancels and requeues a subset, indexes drift. python/go clients use item-level UID to reconcile. parity gap.

emma: could also be caused by chunk-level retries where server returns a partial success and client appends without checking ids. any X-Chunk-Id headers in the logs?

maya: logs show x-chunk-id changed on the retry attempt. original: chunk-a, retry: chunk-b. client merges by array offsets.

ryan: proposed fixes: 1) inject __item_id into each request input and expect it echoed in response.data[i].item_id so client can map deterministically; 2) server validation to reject empty/null embeddings with 500+structured error rather than null; 3) add an opt-in stableOrdering flag in Node helper that toggles uid mapping or positional mapping.

li: +1. For backwards compat, stableOrdering=false should keep old behavior; stableOrdering=true enforces per-item mapping. Add a boolean env EMBED_STABLE_ORDER for sampleapps.

emma: also found envelope inconsistency across runtime versions: some endpoints returned data[i].embeddings (plural) earlier. sampleapp parsers should accept both temporarily. we should map server -> canonical data[i].embedding (singular) and emit a warning header for deprecated forms.

maya: short-term band-aid: set EMBED_BATCH=1 in quickstart to avoid multi-item retries during onboarding. added a note to onboarding doc PR.

ryan: tests: add unit that simulates intermittent 401 halfway through a 4-item batch, ensure mapping handles duplicate/requeued items and returns in-order results without nulls. also add integration test that toggles chunk-id to ensure mapping uses item_id.

li: I'll open a draft PR in redwood/node: map-by-itemid, add stableOrdering flag, update sampleapp, and add tests. cc @maya @ryan.

ci-bot: ci: redwood-node PR #1221 - test job queued (job 8892)

emma: another suggestion: server could include response.metadata.request_map: [{item_id: "u1", index: 0}, ...] which would make client mapping trivial and tolerant of reorder/retries.

ryan: good idea but prefer minimal protocol change first (echo item_id) to ship quickly. can iterate on request_map later.

maya: filed GH issue redwood/node#1221 (onboard: embed batch index race + envelope parity) with repro, logs, and suggested fix. linking here.

li: PR opened: redwood/node#1222, marking as shiproom candidate for this sprint.

maya: thanks team. catching this before too many users hit the sampleapp is a win. :sparkles:
